what_this_is: Research leads for the Leverage Map + Coalition Builder finance layer. Each record is one holder, one right, one target, one decision context, assessed against a fixed rubric of six model-safety conditions. These are NOT application-ready financing opportunities and NOT a drop-in schema for the prototype: every record has unresolved authority, discretion, reach or window questions, recorded explicitly. No record in this file is a currently existing, enforceable, complete model-safety path.
what_this_is_not: Not a count of enforceable opportunities: no record here has both documented discretion and a verified open window.
Not authority transfer: selecting a country in the prototype never grants its government the rights recorded here.
Not a substitute for the retained sources: raw texts stay in .local/finance-evidence/; source_references give per-claim locators into those retained artifacts (indexed in sources.json).
Not a digest of researcher reports: other researchers' notes are claim indexes, not source evidence; every factual claim below is cited to a retained primary source in sources.json.

condition_ids.pre_release_testing: Pre-release testing / evaluator access to the model before deployment.
condition_ids.incident_reporting: Notification/reporting duty; scope distinguishes infrastructure security from proposed model-level incident or harm reporting.
condition_ids.protected_weights: Custody/control obligations over model weights or keys.
condition_ids.essential_user_continuity: Continuity of access or service for essential users if leverage is exercised.
condition_ids.known_chip_locations: Known locations/custody of the compute assets (chips, systems) supporting the model.
condition_ids.local_stop_due_process: A scoped stop of a specific actor/workload with due process, as opposed to whole-instrument termination.

condition_status_vocabulary.existing_in_draft: Text exists in a draft, unsigned instrument. Never counts as an existing power: the instrument is not signed or enforceable today.
condition_status_vocabulary.existing_evidenced: Evidenced in a signed/effective instrument. Requires instrument.instrument_status == 'signed'. No condition in this dataset version carries this status.
condition_status_vocabulary.proposed_reachable: A design proposal that could plausibly attach through this right, with no guarantee of acceptance. A proposed clause never lights an existing-power badge.
condition_status_vocabulary.outside_instrument_scope: The reviewed right does not expressly establish this condition; this is not proof that the whole instrument excludes it.
condition_status_vocabulary.unknown: Cannot be determined on the retained evidence; missing text never establishes absence.

transaction_amount_counting: Records sharing a transaction_id share one financing; count any shared amount once. The three EuroHPC records share transaction eurohpc-aigf-cft-2026.

target.description: The Borrower requests and consents; Loan Parties include the Guarantors that must not hold Material Intellectual Property outside the Guarantor perimeter (s5.12).

records.right: Three documented gate mechanisms: (1) lender sole-discretion elections over new money - any Lender's election to increase or provide a Commitment under s2.21 (Incremental Commitments), to extend under s2.22 (Extensions of Loans and Commitments) or to provide refinancing commitments under s2.23 (Refinancing Amendments) 'shall be in the sole discretion of such Lender'; (2) the amendment gate - except as provided in ss2.14, 2.21, 2.22, 2.23 and s9.08(c)-(h), the agreement may be waived, amended or modified only 'pursuant to an agreement or agreements in writing entered into by the Borrower and the Required Lenders' (s9.08(b)), with enumerated matters (e.g. principal, stated maturity, interest/fees) requiring the prior written consent of each Lender directly adversely affected (s9.08(b)(i)); (3) integration and additional-credit mechanics - s9.08(e) permits amendments with the Required Lenders, the Administrative Agent and the Borrower to allow additional extensions of credit, and s9.08(f) lets the Borrower and Administrative Agent (without Lender consent) integrate loans consistent with ss2.21-2.23.
records.safety_proposal: Design proposal: negotiate a safety-reporting covenant in new incremental credit, an extension, refinancing or an agreed amendment. No explicit model-safety covenant was identified in the reviewed provisions. Keyword absence is not proof of no indirect safety reach; s5.05(b) covered-foreign-person notice and s5.12 Material Intellectual Property restrictions are adjacent provisions. A full clause-by-clause policy review was not performed.
records.rights_vs_proposal_separation: Documented rights concern new-money and amendment consent. No explicit model-safety covenant was identified in the reviewed provisions. They do not establish a right to block committed compliant draws or evidence lender willingness to demand safety terms. New obligations require the Borrower and applicable financing parties to agree.

model_safety_path.basis: The gates are evidenced in the filed agreement, but no explicit model-safety covenant was identified in the reviewed provisions; no complete enforceable model-safety route is established. Present window openness is unknown.

finance.currency_basis: not established on the retained evidence: the text defines multi-currency mechanics (Dollars, Euro, Australian Dollars, New Zealand Dollars, Sterling) but states no aggregate facility currency or amount
finance.amount_basis: amount null: 'SCHEDULE 2.01Commitments[***]' is redacted in the filed exhibit and no aggregate commitment figure appears anywhere in the retained text

window.basis: Windows open only on a Borrower-requested incremental facility (s2.21), extension (s2.22) or refinancing (s2.23), or on a Borrower + Required Lenders amendment (s9.08(b)); all are undated in the retained text, so whether any window is open at any given time - including now - is unknown. Any Lender's participation in a new-money election is in that Lender's sole discretion.

consent.basis: Threshold verified in retained text; allocation unknown because Schedule 2.01 is redacted and signature pages are omitted. Null allocation cannot become zero or an assumed majority.

records.label: Canada to Cohere: announced staged equity investment of up to $1.6 billion (vehicle unnamed; no instrument located)
records.summary: Canada announced staged equity investment of up to $1.6bn in Cohere on 29 October 2026. CAD is inferred from context; the source uses '$'. The investing vehicle, executed terms and future-stage discretion remain unknown. Reporting concerns company commitments, with jobs and investment as non-exhaustive examples. CAISI cooperation is among the announced commitments, but no specific model-safety deliverable or enforcement terms were identified. Signing alone would not settle whether later draws have conditions or remedies.

instrument.name: Government of Canada equity investment in Cohere (Prime Minister's news release, 29 October 2026)
instrument.instrument_status_basis: The release says 'commitment', 'planned' and 'will be made'; no subscription or shareholders agreement, signatory or executed instrument has been located on the raw record.

holder.name: Government of Canada (announced by the Prime Minister)
holder.state_authority_basis: Prime Minister's news release (official release, 2026-10-29); no statute, appropriation or vehicle instrument is cited in the release
holder.vehicle_note: No investing vehicle is named anywhere in the release: 'CDEV', 'Development Investment' and 'Corporation' have zero occurrences in the retained HTML. CDEV is NOT established as the investor: the retained CDEV Act documents a statutory Crown agent with purpose-scoped natural-person capacity (s.9), best-interests-of-Canada and commercial-manner duties (s.10(2)), power to invest including by acquiring shares or securities (s.11(b)), investee-information privilege with four disclosure limbs (s.21(1)-(2)) and Minister-determined authorized capital (s.22) - but capacity is not identity, and if another vehicle (e.g. BDC, a new fund) is the investor, the CDEV Act analysis does not apply to it.

records.safety_proposal: Design proposal only, requiring the company's written assent: attach a safety/integrity covenant or reporting undertaking to the staged investment. Equity can carry operational covenants only with the company's agreement; the announcement contains no veto, reserved matter, consent right or board seat (string searches for 'veto', 'board' and 'consent' return zero hits in the retained release), so nothing evidences any government power to impose terms unilaterally.
records.rights_vs_proposal_separation: The release announces company commitments and regular reporting 'including jobs and investment in Canada'. Those examples are non-exhaustive; CAISI cooperation is also among the commitments. The exact reporting implementation and enforceability are not established by the announcement. No specific government veto, verified safety deliverable, cure period or funding remedy was identified.
